_about: Extra out-of-scope training questions for the scope check (scripts/train_scope.py): everyday matters that are not offences under the IPC (civil, consumer, family, employment, tax, administrative, and offences under other Acts). Written by Claude on 2026-10-15 in the style of the benchmark's scenarios, so the check learns that an everyday narrative is not by itself a crime. None appear in the benchmark or the evaluation sets. Also 20 general non-legal questions, so unrelated topics stay clearly out of scope.
